description: Defines the GrainCancellationToken class which acts as an analogue to CancellationToken for use in Orleans grains, supporting cancellation signaling and distribution across grains.

classes.name: GrainCancellationToken
classes.description: A class that represents a grain-compatible cancellation token, including methods for cancellation, adding grain references, and disposal.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Initiates the cancellation process, either immediately or via an external runtime if provided.

methods.name: AddGrainReference
methods.description: Adds a grain reference to the list of targets for cancellation notifications.
